title: Persistent Symptoms and Referral Escalation Rules
source: NICE Guidelines NG88 (Heavy Menstrual Bleeding) & Endometriosis Society Guidelines

rules.title: Recurrent Heavy Periods Over Multiple Cycles
rules.why: Heavy bleeding that continues across 3 or more cycles can deplete iron reserves and may warrant pelvic investigation.
rules.nextStep: Ask your doctor if a pelvic ultrasound or complete blood count with serum ferritin is recommended.

rules.title: Recurrent Severe Menstrual Pain
rules.why: Severe period pain causing missed school, work, or daily activities across multiple cycles is not something you have to endure and deserves clinical evaluation.
rules.source: Shree IVF / Endometriosis Diagnostic Delay Studies
rules.nextStep: Ask a gynaecologist for a comprehensive evaluation, including whether a pelvic scan is appropriate.

rules.title: Connected Finding: Heavy Menstrual Bleeding and Anaemia
rules.why: Your heavy bleeding score and recorded haemoglobin level suggest heavy bleeding may be contributing to low iron levels.
rules.source: WHO Haemoglobin Guidelines & Higham et al. 1990
rules.nextStep: Please discuss this with a doctor: ask about a ferritin test and evaluating the underlying cause of heavy bleeding.
